I exhausted the 50-forward-pass budget probing for the backdoor trigger. Clean accuracy on the held-in set was **72.3%**. I tested white, checkerboard, and random-noise patches (sizes 3–5) placed 1 pixel in from each corner on images from multiple classes, but the predictions did not change—every triggered image kept its original clean prediction.
